Understanding our approach

SEO, done as a checklist — not a guess

Search Engine Optimization (SEO) is the practice of improving a website's technical health, content, and trust signals so it ranks well, loads fast, and converts visitors — the foundation every other optimization discipline builds on.

Purpose

Rather than relying on a handful of best practices, every Openink Hub SEO engagement is measured against a fixed 132-parameter checklist spanning six categories — so nothing that affects rankings, trust, speed, or conversion is left unchecked.

What's covered

  • Technical SEO & crawlability
  • On-page & content optimization
  • E-E-A-T & trust signals
  • Core Web Vitals & performance
  • UX & accessibility
  • Analytics & conversion tracking

Methodology

Openink Hub SEO Framework

A structured, repeatable process that runs through the full 132-point checklist on every engagement.

01

Full-Site Audit

Run the complete 132-parameter checklist across technical, on-page, trust, performance, UX, and analytics.

02

Technical Fixes

Resolve crawlability, indexability, sitemap, redirect, and structured data issues first.

03

On-Page & Content Optimization

Rebuild titles, headings, keyword targeting, and content depth around real search intent.

04

E-E-A-T & Trust Building

Strengthen authorship, credentials, sourcing, and transparency signals.

05

Performance & UX Tuning

Improve Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and on-site usability.

06

Analytics & Measurement

Connect tracking, conversions, and dashboards so results are provable, not assumed.

The checklist

Our 132-point SEO checklist

Six categories, 132 individual parameters — the exact framework applied to every site we audit. (Answer Engine, Generative Engine, AI Optimization, and AI Discoverability parameters are covered on their dedicated AEO, GEO, and AIO service pages.)
